description.value: White Spot is BC's oldest restaurant chain, founded in 1928 and built around crowd-pleasing comfort food — burgers, fish and chips, and seasonal menu items made with fresh, local ingredients. The Kingsway location sits on a major arterial road through the Burnaby/Vancouver urban corridor, offering a familiar full-service sit-down dining experience with air conditioning and indoor seating. It's a reliable midride stop for a proper meal on one of the busiest cycling routes connecting the two cities.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms White Spot is an active BC restaurant chain with a 'Vancouver (Kingsway)' location listed in their store selector, matching the OSM address at 5550 Kingsway. Takeout is explicitly confirmed by the website ('White Spot takeout is ready when you are!'). Cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill) are not mentioned on the corporate homepage, and OSM diet tags (diet:vegetarian=yes, diet:vegan=limited) cannot be corroborated from the website content provided.
